# 6. UNIST

## A. University snapshot

| Field | Verified answer |
|---|---|
| University | Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology (UNIST) |
| Country / city / campus | Republic of Korea · Ulsan · UNIST campus |
| Type | Public STEM institute |
| Fall 2027 status | **CONFIRMED FOR FALL 2027** |
| Platform | **Study in Korea** |
| Application URL | [Official Fall 2027 notice and files](https://admu-intl.unist.ac.kr/admission-eng/admissions/admissions.do?article.offset=0&mode=list) |
| Best programme | Engineering application field → **Department of Computer Science and Engineering** |
| Degree / language | Bachelor’s; official FAQ states all classes are conducted in English |
| Major structure | Apply to Engineering or Business field; declare department/major after first-year exploration |
| Approximate intake | Guide: approximately **50** international students, with possible additional non-scholarship offers |

## Changes since 13 Sep 2026

- **Correction:** application is through Study in Korea, not an independent UNIST application portal.
- Current guide confirms **no recommendation letter**, a required English-proficiency score and four English responses of up to 700 words each.
- The current guide’s approximate quota (~50) conflicts with an FAQ figure (~40); the cycle-specific guide is controlling.
- The guide explicitly allows additional **non-scholarship** admissions, so an offer does not guarantee the full scholarship package.

## B. Programmes

| Official programme | Degree / school | Structure / prerequisites | Restrictions |
|---|---|---|---|
| Department of Computer Science and Engineering | Bachelor’s; College of Information and Biotechnology | Apply to Engineering; declare major after freshman year. No programme-specific applicant calculus, physics or programming minimum published. | No international/female restriction or public quota by major |
| Department of Electrical Engineering | Bachelor’s; same college in current guide | Secondary route for computer engineering, hardware, embedded systems | Same field-level entry |

**Best programme for me:** Computer Science and Engineering. It directly supports software, AI and data science; EE is secondary for hardware/embedded interests. A newer AI-convergence organization may appear in university news, but the 2027 admissions guide does not offer a separate direct undergraduate AI application choice, so it should not be represented as one.

## C. Application rounds and deadlines

Source: [2027 guide PDF](https://admu-intl.unist.ac.kr/admission-eng/admissions/admissions.do?articleNo=306812&attachNo=591437&mode=download).

| Event | Date/time | Zone | Confirmed? | What must be ready |
|---|---:|---|---|---|
| Application opens | 2 Dec 2026, 09:00 | KST | Yes | Study in Korea account |
| Application + documents | **22 Jan 2027, 16:00** | KST | Yes | Paid/submitted form and two required PDFs |
| Evaluation | 8 Mar–9 Apr 2027 | — | Yes | Monitor contact details |
| Interview, if selected | 29 Mar–9 Apr 2027 | — | Yes | Online/on-site details from UNIST; no rescheduling |
| Decision expected | 7 May 2027 | — | Yes | Portal/email |
| Registration/deposit | 7–18 May 2027 | — | Yes | Deposit under offer instructions; non-refundable once paid |
| Apostilled originals | After registration, announced separately | — | TBA | Final NIS diploma/transcript |
| Housing/visa/orientation | TBA | — | No | After offer |

One Regular-style round is published; it is not labelled binding.

### My recommended timeline

- Request transcript, expected-graduation letter, NIS profile and grading scale by **20 November**.
- Final IELTS/TOEFL sitting by **early December**; score available by **20 December**.
- Draft all four essays by **10 December**; substantive revision by **20 December**.
- Build Study in Korea application and compare live fields on **2 December**.
- Final essays/documents by **8 January**; submit **12–15 January**.
- Keep **29 March–9 April** available and monitor email daily.

## D. Platform and fee

| Item | Rule |
|---|---|
| Platform | Study in Korea |
| Programme choice | Choose Engineering or Business; CS major declared later |
| Upload format | Required records organized into two PDF files under guide directions |
| Editing | A submitted application may require an edit request/portal Edit function and resubmission before deadline; multiple applications are resolved using the latest submission |
| Fee | **KRW 50,000** |
| Refund / waiver | Non-refundable; no waiver published |
| Scholarship fee | None |
| Initial mail | No; upload scans. UNIST may request originals; apostilled records follow admission. |

## E. Document checklist

| Document | Required? | Who submits | When / format | Notes |
|---|---:|---|---|---|
| Study in Korea application | R | Applicant | By 22 Jan, 16:00 KST | Engineering field |
| Personal statement/study plan | R | Applicant | Four English responses in application | 700 words each |
| Passport/national ID | R | Applicant | PDF upload | Applicant citizenship |
| Both parents’ nationality evidence | R | Applicant | PDF upload | Passports/official ID |
| Parent-child relationship document | R | Applicant | Official record + translation if needed | Birth/family certificate |
| Recent three-year HS transcript | R | Applicant uploads school-issued record | By deadline | Include Grade 12/current grades and grading context |
| Expected graduation certificate | R if not graduated | Applicant from school | Principal/school seal | Final record after offer |
| Final NIS certificate/transcript | POST | Applicant/school | Apostilled/legalized after registration at later deadline | Exact date TBA |
| Official English test | **R** | Applicant uploads official result | By deadline | TOEFL/IELTS/TEPS/TOEIC; limited nationality exemption |
| SAT/ACT/IB/A-level/AP/national exam | O | Applicant | Supplemental PDF | No minimum published |
| Awards | O | Applicant | Up to 5 | Evidence only |
| School profile | O / REC | Applicant | Supplemental PDF | Explain NIS |
| TOPIK | O | Applicant | Supplemental | Not an English substitute |
| Recommendation/counselor letter | — | — | — | Not requested in the current guide |
| CV/GitHub/portfolio | — | — | — | No separate required item; mention only where form allows |
| Medical/visa/insurance | POST | Applicant | After offer | Details TBA |

## F. NIS route

- UNIST does not publish NIS-specific grades, Higher Level subject thresholds or a Kazakhstan-specific qualification table.
- An expected-graduation certificate is accepted at application. Submit the NIS school profile and grading scale so the file is not treated as an unexplained ordinary Attestat.
- Predicted NIS results are not expressly addressed. Current Grade 12 records and official expected-graduation evidence are required; optional external academic tests can add comparability.
- The English exemption is nationality-based (US, Canada, UK, Australia, New Zealand, Ireland), not an NIS-medium waiver. A Kazakhstan/NIS applicant must submit an accepted English test.
- Final apostilled records are due after registration at a date announced later; June availability is potentially compatible but needs confirmation.

## G. Academic and testing requirements

### Official minimum

Meet citizenship and graduation eligibility, submit official secondary records and a valid accepted English score. No GPA, NIS, Math/science, SAT or IELTS minimum is published.

### Competitive target — analysis

Strong NIS Math/science grades plus IELTS 7.0–7.5 and a well-evidenced technical profile form a credible file, but UNIST remains competitive. SAT 1300–1350 may help as optional context; it is not an official threshold.

| Test | Rule |
|---|---|
| SAT/ACT | Optional; no minimum, superscore rule or official code published in the guide |
| IB/A-level/AP/national exam | Optional supplemental evidence |
| IELTS | Required option; no overall/band minimum published |
| TOEFL iBT | Required option; institutional code **8807** |
| TEPS / TOEIC | Accepted English options |
| DET / PTE / Cambridge | Not listed in the current guide; do not assume accepted |
| Validity | English score must be within the guide’s two-year validity window |
| Official agency report | Guide requires an official score document; TOEFL code is provided. Exact IELTS e-delivery procedure should be checked in the live application. |

## H. Interview and exams

No routine Math/Physics/programming internal exam is published. UNIST may omit the interview; if invited, it is required, cannot be rescheduled, and can be online or on-site. Questions are based on submitted materials. Current selection weighting for interviewed applicants is **50% document review / 50% interview**.

## I. Recommendations

| Teacher rec | Counselor rec | Second rec | Scholarship rec | Deadline |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Not required | Not required | Not accepted as a listed item | None published | — |

**Strategy:** do not burden teachers with a UNIST-specific letter. Use the counselor for official NIS documents/profile, not a recommendation.

## J. Essays

Source: [official 2027 application form](https://admu-intl.unist.ac.kr/admission-eng/admissions/admissions.do?articleNo=306812&attachNo=591436&mode=download).

| # | Official prompt, faithfully rendered | Limit / language | What it evaluates / useful profile area |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Explain how you overcame financial/social difficulties or physical/emotional challenges that hindered middle/high-school study. | ≤700 words, English | Context, resilience and response; use only if materially true |
| 2 | Describe distinctive qualities of your school and your special academic interests/abilities during secondary education. | ≤700 words, English | NIS rigor, intellectual interests, technical strengths |
| 3 | Describe extracurricular activities and work experience. | ≤700 words, English | Initiative, leadership, projects, research, service and reflection |
| 4 | Explain why UNIST, and your specific academic plans/interests and curriculum path for reaching goals. | ≤700 words, English | Fit, informed planning and CS/AI direction |

All four are required in the form. No separate scholarship essay or video essay is published.

## K. Scholarships and aid

Source: [official scholarship page](https://admu-intl.unist.ac.kr/admission-eng/life/scholarships.do).

| Category | Award | Separate application? | Rule |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Tuition | UNIST tuition scholarship | No | All freshmen first term; thereafter full with ≥12 credits and GPA ≥2.7/4.3, with first-year second-term exception at GPA ≥2.0; half tuition with ≥12 credits and GPA ≥2.0 |
| Living Gold | Merit/living tier | No separate form stated; assigned from admission review | KRW 630k/month plus meal support; ≥12 credits and GPA ≥2.7 |
| Living Silver | Merit/living tier | Same | KRW 330k/month plus meal support; ≥12 credits and GPA ≥2.7 |
| Dream | Lower living tier | Same | KRW 130k/month plus meal support; ≥12 credits and GPA ≥2.0 |
| Health | Insurance reimbursement | Proof-based | Up to KRW 75k/month under current page |
| Meals | Meal support | With assigned scholarship | Two meals/day during semester under current policy |
| Need-based/government | No separate international scheme confirmed | — | Not published |

The admission guide permits additional **non-scholarship** offers. Therefore, scholarship coverage is not guaranteed merely by receiving admission; the offer letter controls.

### Coverage and real gap

| Cost | Covered? | Rule |
|---|---:|---|
| Tuition | Possible full/half | Depends on term and GPA/credits |
| Housing | No explicit waiver | Paid by student unless offer states otherwise |
| Meals | Partial | Two meals/day in regular term for scholarship recipients under current policy |
| Stipend | Tiered | Gold 630k, Silver 330k, Dream 130k/month |
| Insurance | Partial reimbursement | Up to 75k/month with proof |
| Books, visa, flight, laptop, transport, summer housing | Not published as covered | Personal cost |

No reliable annual gap can be calculated without the assigned tier, Fall 2027 housing rate and scholarship status. [Housing page](https://admu-intl.unist.ac.kr/admission-eng/life/housing.do) confirms campus housing resources but does not publish a degree-applicant four-year guarantee or current admissions-cycle price on the reviewed page.

## L. After admission

Accept and register/pay deposit 7–18 May; submit final apostilled/legalized NIS diploma and transcript at the later announced deadline; supply originals if requested; arrange visa, financial proof, insurance and housing; complete arrival/orientation. Deposit is described as non-refundable; exact amount and final-document dates are TBA.

## M. Strategic assessment — analysis

- **Admission difficulty:** Reach / competitive.
- **Full-funding difficulty:** Reach and separate from admission because non-scholarship offers exist and living tiers differ.
- **Fit:** Strong for CSE with broad engineering exploration; essay burden is high but prompts are known.

## N. Still TBA / needs confirmation

NIS predicted-grade treatment; final apostille deadline; IELTS electronic-report process; exact interview medium/duration/questions; scholarship tier selection rule and number of awards; Fall 2027 dorm rate/guarantee; deposit amount; visa/housing dates.

## O. Email question

> I am an NIS Grade 12 applicant from Kazakhstan. My final NIS Certificate will be issued in June 2027. May I apply with my current official transcript and expected-graduation certificate, and submit the final apostilled NIS Certificate after registration? What is the latest final-document date? Please also confirm how an IELTS Academic result should be officially verified for the Study in Korea application.

Apply to Engineering; declare major afte.ru: Подача на Engineering; специальность после первого курса. Минимум для поступающих по математическому анализу, физике или программированию отдельно не опубликован.
Apply to Engineering; declare major afte.en: Apply to Engineering; declare major after freshman year. No programme-specific applicant calculus, physics or programming minimum published.

No international/female restriction or p.en: No international/female restriction or public quota by major

Bachelor’s; same college in current guid.ru: Бакалавриат; тот же колледж в текущем руководстве
Bachelor’s; same college in current guid.en: Bachelor’s; same college in current guide

Secondary route for computer engineering.ru: Второй путь для компьютерной инженерии, аппаратных / встроенных систем
Secondary route for computer engineering.en: Secondary route for computer engineering, hardware, embedded systems

Same field-level entry.ru: То же поступление на общее направление

One Regular-style round is published; it.ru: Опубликован один раунд по типу Regular; он не назван binding.
One Regular-style round is published; it.en: One Regular-style round is published; it is not labelled binding.

Paid/submitted form and two required PDF.ru: Оплаченная / отправленная форма и два обязательных PDF
Paid/submitted form and two required PDF.en: Paid/submitted form and two required PDFs

Online/on-site details from UNIST; no re.ru: Инструкции UNIST для онлайн / очного формата; перенести нельзя
Online/on-site details from UNIST; no re.en: Online/on-site details from UNIST; no rescheduling

Deposit under offer instructions; non-re.ru: Депозит по инструкции оффера; после оплаты невозвратный
Deposit under offer instructions; non-re.en: Deposit under offer instructions; non-refundable once paid

Request transcript, expected-graduation.ru: Запросить транскрипт, письмо об ожидаемом выпуске, профиль NIS и шкалу оценок к **20 ноября**.
Request transcript, expected-graduation.en: Request transcript, expected-graduation letter, NIS profile and grading scale by **20 November**.

Final IELTS/TOEFL sitting by **early Dec.ru: Последняя сдача IELTS/TOEFL — **начало декабря**; результат к **20 декабря**.
Final IELTS/TOEFL sitting by **early Dec.en: Final IELTS/TOEFL sitting by **early December**; score available by **20 December**.

Draft all four essays by **10 December**.ru: Черновики всех четырёх эссе к **10 декабря**; содержательная правка к **20 декабря**.
Draft all four essays by **10 December**.en: Draft all four essays by **10 December**; substantive revision by **20 December**.

Build Study in Korea application and com.ru: Создать заявку Study in Korea и сравнить действующие поля **2 декабря**.
Build Study in Korea application and com.en: Build Study in Korea application and compare live fields on **2 December**.

Final essays/documents by **8 January**;.ru: Завершить эссе / документы к **8 января**; подать **12–15 января**.
Final essays/documents by **8 January**;.en: Final essays/documents by **8 January**; submit **12–15 January**.

Keep **29 March–9 April** available and.ru: Оставить **29 марта – 9 апреля** свободными и проверять email ежедневно.
Keep **29 March–9 April** available and.en: Keep **29 March–9 April** available and monitor email daily.

Choose Engineering or Business; CS major.ru: Выбрать Engineering или Business; CS выбирается позднее
Choose Engineering or Business; CS major.en: Choose Engineering or Business; CS major declared later

Required records organized into two PDF.ru: Обязательные документы организованы в два PDF по инструкции руководства
Required records organized into two PDF.en: Required records organized into two PDF files under guide directions

A submitted application may require an e.ru: Для правок отправленной заявки могут потребоваться запрос / функция Edit портала и повторная отправка до дедлайна; при нескольких заявках используется последняя отправленная
A submitted application may require an e.en: A submitted application may require an edit request/portal Edit function and resubmission before deadline; multiple applications are resolved using the latest submission

Non-refundable; no waiver published.ru: Невозвратный; освобождение от оплаты не опубликовано

No; upload scans. UNIST may request orig.ru: Нет; загрузить сканы. UNIST может запросить оригиналы; документы с апостилем предоставляются после поступления.
No; upload scans. UNIST may request orig.en: No; upload scans. UNIST may request originals; apostilled records follow admission.

Four English responses in application.ru: Четыре ответа на английском в заявке

Parent-child relationship document.ru: Документ о связи родителей с ребёнком

Recent three-year HS transcript.ru: Транскрипт старшей школы за последние три года

Include Grade 12/current grades and grad.ru: Включить Grade 12 / текущие оценки и контекст оценивания
Include Grade 12/current grades and grad.en: Include Grade 12/current grades and grading context

R if not graduated.ru: R — если школа ещё не окончена

Apostilled/legalized after registration.ru: Апостиль / легализация после регистрации к более позднему сроку
Apostilled/legalized after registration.en: Apostilled/legalized after registration at later deadline

Not requested in the current guide.en: Not requested in the current guide

No separate required item; mention only.ru: Отдельного обязательного пункта нет; упоминать только в разрешённых полях
No separate required item; mention only.en: No separate required item; mention only where form allows

UNIST does not publish NIS-specific grad.ru: UNIST не публикует отдельных оценок NIS, порогов Higher Level или таблицы квалификаций Казахстана.
UNIST does not publish NIS-specific grad.en: UNIST does not publish NIS-specific grades, Higher Level subject thresholds or a Kazakhstan-specific qualification table.

An expected-graduation certificate is ac.ru: Подтверждение ожидаемого выпуска принимается при подаче. Предоставьте профиль школы NIS и шкалу оценок, чтобы заявку не рассматривали как необъяснённый обычный Attestat.
An expected-graduation certificate is ac.en: An expected-graduation certificate is accepted at application. Submit the NIS school profile and grading scale so the file is not treated as an unexplained ordinary Attestat.

Predicted NIS results are not expressly.ru: Прогнозные NIS прямо не описаны. Нужны текущие документы Grade 12 и официальное подтверждение ожидаемого выпуска; необязательные внешние тесты повышают сопоставимость.
Predicted NIS results are not expressly.en: Predicted NIS results are not expressly addressed. Current Grade 12 records and official expected-graduation evidence are required; optional external academic tests can add comparability.

The English exemption is nationality-bas.ru: Освобождение от английского зависит от гражданства (США, Канада, Великобритания, Австралия, Новая Зеландия, Ирландия), не языка NIS. Кандидату из Казахстана / NIS нужен принимаемый тест английского.
The English exemption is nationality-bas.en: The English exemption is nationality-based (US, Canada, UK, Australia, New Zealand, Ireland), not an NIS-medium waiver. A Kazakhstan/NIS applicant must submit an accepted English test.

Final apostilled records are due after r.ru: Итоговые документы с апостилем подаются после регистрации к объявляемой позднее дате; июньский выпуск потенциально совместим, но требует подтверждения.
Final apostilled records are due after r.en: Final apostilled records are due after registration at a date announced later; June availability is potentially compatible but needs confirmation.

Meet citizenship and graduation eligibil.ru: Соответствовать гражданству и выпуску, предоставить официальные школьные документы и действующий принимаемый результат английского. Минимум GPA, NIS, математики / естественных наук, SAT или IELTS не опубликован.
Meet citizenship and graduation eligibil.en: Meet citizenship and graduation eligibility, submit official secondary records and a valid accepted English score. No GPA, NIS, Math/science, SAT or IELTS minimum is published.

Strong NIS Math/science grades plus IELT.ru: Сильные оценки NIS по математике / естественным наукам, IELTS 7.0–7.5 и проверяемый технический профиль дают убедительную заявку, но конкурс остаётся высоким. SAT 1300–1350 может помочь как необязательный контекст, не официальный порог.
Strong NIS Math/science grades plus IELT.en: Strong NIS Math/science grades plus IELTS 7.0–7.5 and a well-evidenced technical profile form a credible file, but UNIST remains competitive. SAT 1300–1350 may help as optional context; it is not an official threshold.

Optional; no minimum, superscore rule or.ru: Необязательно; минимум, superscore и официальный код в руководстве не опубликованы
Optional; no minimum, superscore rule or.en: Optional; no minimum, superscore rule or official code published in the guide

Required option; no overall/band minimum.ru: Один из обязательных вариантов; общий / компонентный минимум не опубликован
Required option; no overall/band minimum.en: Required option; no overall/band minimum published

Required option; institutional code **88.ru: Один из обязательных вариантов; код учреждения **8807**

Not listed in the current guide; do not.ru: Не перечислены в текущем руководстве; не предполагать, что принимаются
Not listed in the current guide; do not.en: Not listed in the current guide; do not assume accepted

English score must be within the guide’s.ru: Результат английского должен попадать в двухлетний срок действия руководства
English score must be within the guide’s.en: English score must be within the guide’s two-year validity window

Guide requires an official score documen.ru: Руководство требует официальный документ результата; код TOEFL указан. Точный порядок электронной отправки IELTS проверить в действующей заявке.
Guide requires an official score documen.en: Guide requires an official score document; TOEFL code is provided. Exact IELTS e-delivery procedure should be checked in the live application.

No routine Math/Physics/programming inte.ru: Регулярный внутренний экзамен по математике / физике / программированию не опубликован. UNIST может не проводить интервью; при приглашении оно обязательно, не переносится и может быть онлайн или очным. Вопросы основаны на заявке. Текущий вес для проходящих интервью: **50% документы / 50% интервью**.
No routine Math/Physics/programming inte.en: No routine Math/Physics/programming internal exam is published. UNIST may omit the interview; if invited, it is required, cannot be rescheduled, and can be online or on-site. Questions are based on submitted materials. Current selection weighting for interviewed applicants is **50% document review / 50% interview**.

**Strategy:** do not burden teachers wit.ru: **Стратегия — анализ:** не нагружать учителей отдельным письмом UNIST. Консультант готовит официальные документы / профиль NIS, не рекомендацию.
**Strategy:** do not burden teachers wit.en: **Strategy:** do not burden teachers with a UNIST-specific letter. Use the counselor for official NIS documents/profile, not a recommendation.

Not accepted as a listed item.en: Not accepted as a listed item

All four are required in the form. No se.ru: Все четыре ответа обязательны в форме. Отдельное эссе на стипендию или видеоэссе не опубликованы.
All four are required in the form. No se.en: All four are required in the form. No separate scholarship essay or video essay is published.

Official prompt, faithfully rendered.ru: Опубликованный вопрос в передаче аудита, не заверенный дословный оригинал

What it evaluates / useful profile area.en: What it evaluates / useful profile area

Explain how you overcame financial/socia.ru: Объясните, как вы преодолевали финансовые / социальные трудности или физические / эмоциональные сложности, мешавшие учёбе в средней / старшей школе.
Explain how you overcame financial/socia.en: Explain how you overcame financial/social difficulties or physical/emotional challenges that hindered middle/high-school study.

Context, resilience and response; use on.ru: Контекст, устойчивость и ваши действия; использовать только существенные правдивые обстоятельства
Context, resilience and response; use on.en: Context, resilience and response; use only if materially true

Describe distinctive qualities of your s.ru: Опишите особенности вашей школы и свои особые академические интересы / способности во время среднего образования.
Describe distinctive qualities of your s.en: Describe distinctive qualities of your school and your special academic interests/abilities during secondary education.

NIS rigor, intellectual interests, techn.ru: Сложность NIS, интеллектуальные интересы, технические сильные стороны
NIS rigor, intellectual interests, techn.en: NIS rigor, intellectual interests, technical strengths

Describe extracurricular activities and.ru: Опишите внеучебную деятельность и опыт работы.
Describe extracurricular activities and.en: Describe extracurricular activities and work experience.

Initiative, leadership, projects, resear.ru: Инициатива, лидерство, проекты, исследования, помощь обществу и осмысление опыта
Initiative, leadership, projects, resear.en: Initiative, leadership, projects, research, service and reflection

Explain why UNIST, and your specific aca.ru: Объясните, почему UNIST, ваши конкретные академические планы / интересы и путь по учебному плану для достижения целей.
Explain why UNIST, and your specific aca.en: Explain why UNIST, and your specific academic plans/interests and curriculum path for reaching goals.

Fit, informed planning and CS/AI directi.ru: Соответствие вузу, обоснованный план и направление CS/AI
Fit, informed planning and CS/AI directi.en: Fit, informed planning and CS/AI direction

The admission guide permits additional *.ru: Руководство допускает дополнительные офферы **без стипендии**. Поэтому поступление само по себе не гарантирует покрытие; приоритет у письма с оффером.
The admission guide permits additional *.en: The admission guide permits additional **non-scholarship** offers. Therefore, scholarship coverage is not guaranteed merely by receiving admission; the offer letter controls.

All freshmen first term; thereafter full.ru: Всем первокурсникам первый семестр; затем полностью при ≥12 кредитах и GPA ≥2.7/4.3, с исключением второго семестра первого курса при GPA ≥2.0; половина обучения при ≥12 кредитах и GPA ≥2.0
All freshmen first term; thereafter full.en: All freshmen first term; thereafter full with ≥12 credits and GPA ≥2.7/4.3, with first-year second-term exception at GPA ≥2.0; half tuition with ≥12 credits and GPA ≥2.0

Merit/living tier.ru: Уровень поддержки за достижения / на жизнь

No separate form stated; assigned from a.ru: Отдельная форма не указана; назначение по результатам рассмотрения заявки
No separate form stated; assigned from a.en: No separate form stated; assigned from admission review

KRW 630k/month plus meal support; ≥12 cr.ru: KRW 630 000 в месяц плюс питание; ≥12 кредитов и GPA ≥2.7
KRW 630k/month plus meal support; ≥12 cr.en: KRW 630k/month plus meal support; ≥12 credits and GPA ≥2.7

KRW 330k/month plus meal support; ≥12 cr.ru: KRW 330 000 в месяц плюс питание; ≥12 кредитов и GPA ≥2.7
KRW 330k/month plus meal support; ≥12 cr.en: KRW 330k/month plus meal support; ≥12 credits and GPA ≥2.7

KRW 130k/month plus meal support; ≥12 cr.ru: KRW 130 000 в месяц плюс питание; ≥12 кредитов и GPA ≥2.0
KRW 130k/month plus meal support; ≥12 cr.en: KRW 130k/month plus meal support; ≥12 credits and GPA ≥2.0

Up to KRW 75k/month under current page.ru: До KRW 75 000 в месяц по текущей странице
Up to KRW 75k/month under current page.en: Up to KRW 75k/month under current page

Two meals/day during semester under curr.ru: Два приёма пищи в день в семестр по действующим правилам
Two meals/day during semester under curr.en: Two meals/day during semester under current policy

No reliable annual gap can be calculated.ru: Надёжные годовые непокрытые расходы нельзя рассчитать без назначенного уровня, тарифов жилья Fall 2027 и статуса стипендии. [Страница проживания](https://admu-intl.unist.ac.kr/admission-eng/life/housing.do) подтверждает кампусное жильё, но на проверенной странице нет гарантии всех четырёх лет для полного бакалавриата или текущего тарифа набора.
No reliable annual gap can be calculated.en: No reliable annual gap can be calculated without the assigned tier, Fall 2027 housing rate and scholarship status. [Housing page](https://admu-intl.unist.ac.kr/admission-eng/life/housing.do) confirms campus housing resources but does not publish a degree-applicant four-year guarantee or current admissions-cycle price on the reviewed page.

Depends on term and GPA/credits.ru: Зависит от семестра и GPA / кредитов

Paid by student unless offer states othe.ru: Оплачивает студент, если оффер не говорит иное
Paid by student unless offer states othe.en: Paid by student unless offer states otherwise

Two meals/day in regular term for schola.ru: Два приёма пищи в день в обычный семестр для стипендиатов по текущим правилам
Two meals/day in regular term for schola.en: Two meals/day in regular term for scholarship recipients under current policy

Books, visa, flight, laptop, transport,.ru: Учебники, виза, перелёт, ноутбук, транспорт, проживание летом
Books, visa, flight, laptop, transport,.en: Books, visa, flight, laptop, transport, summer housing

Accept and register/pay deposit 7–18 May.ru: Принять оффер и зарегистрироваться / оплатить депозит 7–18 мая; предоставить итоговый диплом / транскрипт NIS с апостилем / легализацией к позднее объявленному сроку; оригиналы по запросу; оформить визу, финансовое подтверждение, страховку и жильё; пройти подготовку приезда / ориентацию. Депозит невозвратный; точная сумма и сроки итоговых документов — TBA.
Accept and register/pay deposit 7–18 May.en: Accept and register/pay deposit 7–18 May; submit final apostilled/legalized NIS diploma and transcript at the later announced deadline; supply originals if requested; arrange visa, financial proof, insurance and housing; complete arrival/orientation. Deposit is described as non-refundable; exact amount and final-document dates are TBA.

**Full-funding difficulty:** Reach and s.ru: **Сложность полного финансирования:** высокая, отдельно от поступления: возможны офферы без стипендии, уровни выплат отличаются.
**Full-funding difficulty:** Reach and s.en: **Full-funding difficulty:** Reach and separate from admission because non-scholarship offers exist and living tiers differ.

**Fit:** Strong for CSE with broad engin.ru: **Соответствие профилю:** хорошо для CSE с широким изучением инженерии; эссе много, но вопросы известны.
**Fit:** Strong for CSE with broad engin.en: **Fit:** Strong for CSE with broad engineering exploration; essay burden is high but prompts are known.

NIS predicted-grade treatment; final apo.ru: Порядок прогнозных NIS; срок апостиля; электронная отправка IELTS; формат / длительность / вопросы интервью; правило назначения уровня стипендии и число наград; тариф / гарантия жилья Fall 2027; сумма депозита; сроки визы / жилья.
NIS predicted-grade treatment; final apo.en: NIS predicted-grade treatment; final apostille deadline; IELTS electronic-report process; exact interview medium/duration/questions; scholarship tier selection rule and number of awards; Fall 2027 dorm rate/guarantee; deposit amount; visa/housing dates.

I am an NIS Grade 12 applicant from Kaza.ru: Я кандидат NIS Grade 12 из Казахстана. Итоговый сертификат получу в июне 2027. Можно ли подать текущий официальный транскрипт и подтверждение ожидаемого выпуска, а итоговый сертификат NIS с апостилем — после регистрации? Каков крайний срок итоговых документов? Как официально подтвердить IELTS Academic для заявки Study in Korea?
I am an NIS Grade 12 applicant from Kaza.en: I am an NIS Grade 12 applicant from Kazakhstan. My final NIS Certificate will be issued in June 2027. May I apply with my current official transcript and expected-graduation certificate, and submit the final apostilled NIS Certificate after registration? What is the latest final-document date? Please also confirm how an IELTS Academic result should be officially verified for the Study in Korea application.

Final apostilled documents after registr.ru: Итоговые документы с апостилем после регистрации
